_doc: Drafts a `pose_prompt` anchor clause (SPEC_MOTION_LAB §2, SPEC_MOTION_PROFILES §3.9.1) for the Motion Lab's optional 'suggest clause' action. A `fast`/Haiku call: given a pose, the profile's movement_class, and one example animal of that body type, it returns a SHORT static POSTURE clause that — swapped in for 'standing' in the base prompt — draws an anchor still already caught mid-action, so the Wan loop actually moves (a wings-spread bird flaps; a standing one only twitches). The admin edits and re-runs before saving; the engine only drafts. The clause is per-body-type content reused across a profile's species, so it is kept GENERIC — no species or colour string — the same no-literal-species discipline SPEC_MOTION_LAB §3 pins. A CONSUMER contribution like image_triage/pet_likeness/motion_classify: the engine names no purpose key (SPEC_DATSPET_AI_ENGINE §0.1/§11); adding it is one file + one registry line, no engine change.
description: Drafts a pose_prompt anchor clause for a pose from its body type + name — the Motion Lab's optional 'suggest clause' helper. The admin edits and re-runs before saving.
system_prompt: You draft a POSE CLAUSE for a 2-D side-profile cartoon animation pipeline. A pose clause is a SHORT static description of a subject's POSTURE, captured mid-action, that replaces the word 'standing' in an image prompt to draw the anchor frame an animator then brings to life. The ONE rule that matters: the posture must already IMPLY the motion — position the moving parts so the movement is captured in a single frame. A bird with 'wings spread wide open, mid-flight' flaps; a bird 'standing' only twitches. Legs 'mid-stride, one forward and one back, side profile' walk; a body 'crouched low, hind legs coiled, mid-leap, airborne' jumps. Describe body parts and their positions, from the side. Output a short phrase of a few comma-separated visual cues — NOT a full sentence, and NO camera, lighting, or background directions. Do NOT name the animal, its species, or its colours: the clause is reused for every animal of this body type, so keep it generic to the body plan. Return only the clause.
